subject: Engagement roadmap & next steps — Synapse Medical
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Emily Chan <emily.chan@synapse-med.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@synapse-med.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Engaging Synapse — call recap & proposed timeline

Hi Emily / Amit —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of decisions and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what's important to you:
- Low-latency inference (p95 < 150ms) for chart autopopulate flows
- Data controls / on-prem option for PHI handling
- Predictable cost targets for 24/7 traffic pattern; projected steady state ~3M tokens/day

Proposed engagement roadmap (high level):
1) POC kickoff (Dec 6) — data & access, baseline perf tests — owner: Synapse + Redwood SE (Marissa) — duration: 2 weeks
2) Integration sprint (Dec 20) — embed models, routing, KV cache tuning — owner: Synapse infra + Redwood infra (Karthik) — duration: 3 weeks
3) Pilot & validation (Jan 12) — QA, latency SLA validation, security review — owner: Synapse product + Redwood solutions (Stephanie) — duration: 2 weeks
4) Target commercial go-live (Feb 1) — target close date: Feb 1, 2027

Dependencies we flagged:
- Synapse must provision a test VPC and share firewall rules (due Dec 3)
- SOC2 evidence review for PHI handling (Synapse security to share checklist by Dec 10)
- Decision on Dedicated vs Private deployment by Jan 7 to finalize pricing

I've attached a first-pass engagement roadmap (Synapse-Engagement-Roadmap-v1.0.xlsx) and the POC config notes we discussed. Can you confirm owners for the VPC and security checklist items? Also, does Feb 1 look like a realistic target for commercial go-live?

Next steps:
- Emily/Amit: confirm VPC owner and an internal contact for the SOC2 checklist (reply) — due: 2026-12-03
- Redwood: finalize POC runbook and send calendar invites for kickoff — owner: Marissa — due: 2026-12-04

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Synapse-Engagement-Roadmap-v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Redwood-POC-Config-Notes.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Dr. Emily Chan <emily.chan@synapse-med.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@synapse-med.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Engaging Synapse — call recap & proposed timeline

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our internal thinking. Quick answers: 
- VPC owner: Amit Rao (cc'd) will own provisioning and firewall rules. He expects the VPC ready by Dec 2 (can confirm exact CIDR later).
- SOC2 checklist: I'll loop in our security lead separately, but I can confirm we'll have the initial doc ready for Redwood by Dec 9.
- Target close: Feb 1 is aggressive but doable if we keep these milestones tight.

One ask from our side: can Redwood provide an example of the Dedicated vs Private cost delta for our expected token profile? A short spreadsheet / ballpark is fine.

Emily
Dr. Emily Chan
VP Product, Synapse Medical Systems

Team —

Emily confirmed VPC owner (Amit) and SOC2 doc timeline. They asked for a Dedicated vs Private cost delta. Action items for us before the Dec 6 kickoff: 
- Marissa: finalize POC runbook and include a short checklist for required Synapse artifacts (data samples, access keys, sample traffic) — due Nov 30 EOD
- Karthik: draft a two-tab cost comparison (expected tokens/day, expected p95 latency impact) and include quantization/throughput tradeoffs — due Dec 1
- Stephanie: prepare a SOC2 evidence mapping doc (what we can share, what requires NDA) — due Dec 3

Also, I updated the engagement roadmap and attached v1.1 with clearer owners and a provisional milestone for legal and procurement (internal review week of Jan 18). Please review and flag anything missing.

Thanks — Vivek

Hi Emily / Amit —

Quick weekly check-in and nudge on a couple of open items before our Dec 6 kickoff:
- VPC firewall rules (Amit) — status: PENDING (needed by Dec 3)
- Synapse to share a representative PHI data sample (anonymized) — status: OVERDUE by 1 day (requested Nov 27)
- SOC2 checklist draft (Emily/security) — status: PENDING (expected Dec 9)

I've attached Synapse-Engagement-Roadmap-v1.2 which:
- consolidates milestones, owners, and expected deliverable dates
- marks dependencies and flags the two gating items above
- adds a short column with Redwood's recommended initial model sizing for the POC

Please see the highlighted "Action Required" cells for the VPC owner and data sample. If either of those slips, we risk pushing the POC kickoff by one week which would move the commercial target beyond Feb 1.

Amit — can you confirm a firm date for firewall rules? Emily — any chance the anonymized sample can be shared by EOD tomorrow?
